status: phase 3 reviewed; material recommendations require correction before final use
accepted_with_qualification: Keep matched four-year timing convention explicit; target is not raw NCHS mean.
Wealth-level old-age dispersion is a concrete candidate matching the current constant-income model operator; it needs a new contract, not silent replacement.
Common-scale entry wealth avoids own-earnings small denominators, but construction and censoring must be explicit.
Maintain external bequest target only as a borrowed restriction with concept and synthetic-tolerance caveats.
ACS geography follows the represented population, not fit.
not_accepted: A same-phase +3-minus-1 aggregate is not certified by numerical similarity to +2-minus-2: saved null-direction witness changes the former without changing fitted observations.
No basis to privilege birth-date-only housing over the four-year advanced branch; data include later births and elapsed-time matching requires an explicit convention.
A common shift in child-dependent preferences does not generally cancel in differences of endogenous conditional rooms across heterogeneous parents.
An extra coordinate in non-nested utility families does not mechanically guarantee lower loss.
Wave-specific normalized wealth means do not generally equal a pooled ratio of sums; grouped discretization need not preserve rank correlation exactly.
Newly infeasible entry mass cannot silently be censored or set to zero under the current wealth-law contract.
The fixed production 2.1 closure is real, but changing it does not prove stationary models in general impossible. Top-bin replacement is an economic change, not merely a label.
new_evidence_for_next_phase: Common-cohort room contrasts .811397/.797759 are invariant to additive cohort constants, with changed composition/weights and no covariance-based SE. Independent review saved.
ACS parent pointers reproduce NCHILD categories; candidate minor-only family-room gap .336220 versus .347067, no bootstrap, not model-dependent validation.
Luna verifying late-fertility stock-versus-flow claims from saved receipts; no new solve.
